cohort: Thirty-eight patients diagnosed with d-storage pool disease (d-SPD) between 2016 and 2024 were included.
finding: The perioperative/peripartum bleeding rate in patients with d-SPD decreased significantly after correct diagnosis and was significantly lower among patients who received preventive treatment before the procedure.
mod_finding: Among deliveries, 9 out of 10 vaginal deliveries experienced postpartum hemorrhage (6 of which had no prophylaxis), whereas all 6 cesarean sections received prophylactic platelet transfusion and experienced no bleeding.
